settings.title: Settings
settings.first_login_desc: Log in to the admin interface as user "admin" with the temporary password: {password} — change it immediately. This password is only shown until you change it.
settings.first_login_log: The temporary password for user "admin" was written to the container log on first start. If it is no longer shown here, retrieve it from the log or reset the database.
settings.admin_host_helper: FQDN of the admin interface (web UI and REST API). Published through Traefik, TLS terminated by Traefik.
settings.phish_host_helper: Optional. FQDN under which the module publishes the phishing landing pages through its own Traefik route. Leave empty to route the phishing port yourself in Traefik, with one or more FQDNs each getting its own certificate. Must differ from the admin host.
settings.contact_address_helper: Optional. Shown to recipients who report a simulated phishing e-mail.
settings.invalid_host: Enter a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.hosts_must_differ: The phishing host must differ from the admin host
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Host name already used by another application
settings.phish_manual_title: Phishing route is yours to create
settings.phish_manual_desc: No phishing host name is set, so the module does not publish a route for it. Create one or more routes in Traefik pointing at {target}, each with its own host name and Let's Encrypt certificate. GoPhish tells the campaigns apart by the link, not the host name, so several landing-page domains can share this one target.
